title: What if my gifts are just noise?
keyTakeaway: Speech without love is just noise — a clanging cymbal. Love is the more excellent way.
scriptureText: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
keywords: speak love noise cymbal gong tongues angels gifts paul excellent way 1 corinthians 13

title: Can I serve God and still miss knowing Him?
keyTakeaway: Being used by God is not the same as being known by Him; gifts without love still hear “I never knew you.”
scriptureText: Many will say to Me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in Your name, cast out demons in Your name, and done many wonders in Your name?’ And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you who practice lawlessness!’
keywords: matthew 7:22 7:23 i never knew you gifts without love prophesy cast out demons mighty works known by god 1 corinthians 13:2

title: Does real love insist on its own way?
keyTakeaway: Love … does not seek its own, … thinks no evil.
scriptureText: Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

scriptureText: If that nation against whom I have spoken turns from its evil, I will relent of the disaster that I thought to bring upon it. But if they do not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, says the LORD.

scriptureText: So shall My word be that goes forth from My mouth; It shall not return to Me void, But it shall accomplish what I please, And it shall prosper in the thing for which I sent it.

title: Is church really boring?
keyTakeaway: Church felt boring when he refused to get involved; David was glad to go to the house of the Lord, and the church is the people who make it up.
scriptureText: I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go into the house of the LORD.”

title: Should church be as consistent as a Big Mac?
keyTakeaway: A Big Mac is identical everywhere; Paul says believers should speak the same thing, so the Holy Ghost, salvation and holy living should be preached the same in every church.
scriptureText: Now I plead with you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

title: Can a divided home still stand?
keyTakeaway: A husband and wife need to stand together in the same truth and moral standards, showing their children Jesus by example, or the home will not stand.
scriptureText: But Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.”

scriptureText: Now I say this, that each of you says, “I am of Paul,” or “I am of Apollos,” or “I am of Cephas,” or “I am of Christ.” Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
